rationale: The short thesis depended on price failing below the 5m 9-EMA, but the latest 1m candle reclaimed it (close $250.08 vs 9-EMA $249.87) on a sharp volume spike (13,861 vs prior sub-1.4k bars), pushing toward the $250.60 invalidation.
